task: Write a short team message with these seven constraints: (1) 161 to 161 words inclusive; a word is a match of [A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?, so punctuation is not a word. (2) Include the whole word "maple" ignoring case. (3) Do not use the whole word "always" ignoring case. (4) No digits. (5) Exactly 2 nonempty paragraphs separated by a blank line. (6) Begin exactly "Dear team,". (7) End exactly "Kind regards.".

Dear team,

I wanted to share a quick update regarding the upcoming project milestone. We've been diligently working on refining the core functionality, specifically focusing on the user interface and data integration. Initial testing suggests a generally positive response, with some minor adjustments needed before final deployment. The design team has presented a fantastic mockup incorporating a beautiful maple leaf motif – a subtle nod to our brand identity, which we believe will resonate well with our target audience. We're currently prioritizing bug fixes and performance optimization to ensure a seamless user experience. Let’s keep the momentum going and collaborate effectively to achieve our goals.

Furthermore, I’d like to emphasize the importance of clear communication throughout this phase. Regular check-ins and open feedback are crucial to maintaining a cohesive workflow. We should strive for proactive problem-solving and support each other’s efforts.  Remember to document all changes thoroughly. Let’s continue to build upon our collective strengths, leveraging our expertise to deliver an exceptional product.  I appreciate everyone’s dedication and commitment to this project’s success. Kind regards.

Dear team,

This message concerns the upcoming project deliverables and a quick check-in on progress. We're nearing the crucial phase of integrating the various components, and keen attention to detail is paramount. Remember to thoroughly test each module before submitting for compilation. Consider potential edge cases and scenarios that might not be immediately apparent. The design document, particularly the section outlining the user interface, should be your guiding star. I envision a smooth rollout, resembling the rich, vibrant color of maple leaves in autumn. Collaboration and open communication remain key to our success, so don’t hesitate to reach out if encountering any roadblocks or needing assistance.

Let's ensure all code is properly commented and adheres to the established style guidelines. This will greatly aid in future maintenance and troubleshooting. We've built a strong foundation; now it’s time to refine and polish. Remember to document any deviations from the original plan, along with the rationale behind them. A proactive approach to problem-solving will prevent surprises down the line. This is a fantastic opportunity to showcase our collective expertise and deliver a truly exceptional product. 

Kind regards.
